notes.title: "Rizufuri-tan!" Demo is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
🎶 Flip, Remember, and Groove! 🎶
We’ve just released the demo for our memory-flipping rhythm game, "Rizufuri-tan!" 🙌

Try out the gameplay and world of "Rizufuri-tan!" in this demo! If you have any thoughts, feedback, or bugs to report, share them on social media with [url=https://x.com/search?q=%23%E3%83%AA%E3%82%BA%E3%83%95%E3%83%AA%E3%81%9F%E3%82%93&src=typed_query]#リズフリたん[/url]—we’ll be watching! 👀💨💨💨

📅 We're aiming for a full release in 2025 with 8+ songs! 💪
If you like the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! ✨

[h3]📝 Demo Features [/h3]
[list]
[*] 🎮 Play up to Stage 4
[*] 🔐 Unlock new stages by clearing the previous one
[*] 💬 Currently, UI is Japanese only (English support coming in the full version!)
[/list]
